messages:
mike: Heads-up — canary for v3.5.2 in us-west2 showing p95 latency +28% after 15m. Deploy-bot flagged SLA-exception. Rolling threshold at 20%.

deploy-bot: AUTOMATION: Canary alert: p95 latency >20% for 10m. Suggested action: auto-rollback to v3.5.1 in 5m unless human hold. /runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/rollback

sasha: Oncall — do we want auto-rollback or manual? This is mostly tail latency on embeddings route.

elaine: embeddings team says new kernel causes KV cache churn. We should hold for 10 more mins and try clearing cache on canary nodes first. That might stabilize.

tj: If we hold, can we pin dedicated customers to previous version? Need to notify any dedicated pool owners.

mike: @tj good call. I'll open an ops ticket to pin dedicated pools for accounts A123,B234. Also prepping release note rollback blurb.

deploy-bot: ACTIONABLE: Hold placed by mike. Auto-rollback disabled for thread 2478009999. Manual rollback window expires in 30m.

sasha: I'll try a targeted KV cache flush: `kubectl exec -n inference svc/cache-manager -- /bin/sh -c "flush_kv_prefix embeddings"` and watch p95. Anyone available to run?

elaine: Running it now on canary. Will post results in 2m.

elaine: flush done — p95 dropped from 420ms to 210ms on the canary slice. Still ~10% above baseline but trending down. Recommend we keep hold and continue monitoring for 15m. :thumbsup:

tj: I'll message the dedicated customers with a heads-up: brief status, potential rollback, ETA 30m. Draft: "We're investigating canary latency increase for v3.5.2; we're holding rollout and may rollback if no improvement. We'll update in 30m." @mike ok to send?

mike: Send it. Also ask sales to not push new onboardings to the affected pool.

sasha: Agreed. If we need to rollback, who's executing? @ops-runner?

ops-runner: I can perform manual rollback. Runbook step: `redwood deploy rollback --release v3.5.1 --scope production --force` then monitor metrics. Will coordinate with @mike for timing.

mike: Good. Keep thread updates concise. If metrics degrade again, ops-runner, proceed with rollback. Otherwise plan to resume rollout after 2h canary window and add kernel flag revert for next patch.
